statement: China's MIIT plan targets 9,800 exaflops of AI computing capacity by 2030, backed by $532 billion of infrastructure investment over five years, up from 2,185 exaflops in June 2026.
why: A state-funded capacity target of this size, built on domestic silicon, is the largest single source of accelerator supply outside the Western merchant chain.

impact.mechanism: State investment scales domestically produced compute clusters, adding non-merchant accelerator supply while absorbing memory, power and packaging capacity.

evidence.excerpt: 2030 Target: 9,800 exaflops of AI computing capacity by 2030
China had 1,590 exaflops in 2025 and 2,185 exaflops by June 2026

confidence.basis: Single low-profile secondary outlet paraphrasing a government plan; the underlying MIIT document was not fetched.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 52.0 -> 9800.0 (tol 1%); sources: qrcodepress.com
